findings: Test agent 'TEST_RESTRICTED_ATTE' created during automated tests was left in config/agents.json.
Test agent 'SECURITY_AUDIT_L0' created during run_security_depth_suite.py was left in config/agents.json.
Test agent 'SNEAKYL0AGENT' created during run_security_depth_suite.py was left in config/agents.json.

Root cause: run_security_depth_suite.py calls registry.save_agent_profile() which permanently commits to disk (config/agents.json), but its finally block only pruned in-memory registry._lock without calling registry.delete_agent() or sm/file delete.
Suite D created conversation 'conv_1de754160a93' ('Suite D Verification Thread') which remains persisted in agent_conversations and agent_messages.
Suite D created 12 uncleaned conversations for MICHAEL and VERVE with title 'New Conversation'.
Suite L created conversations for AGENT_ALPHA and AGENT_BETA ('conv_agent1_34ebbdc9', 'conv_agent2_43a19ae5', 'conv_8e3504998650') which remain persisted.
SQLite stress testing (Subagent 19) inserted 100 rapid turns and session condensation 'stress_test_cond_7089fcf6', and left 2 memory_conflicts rows.
Root cause: Test harnesses executed against the production database 'memory/zezo_brain.db' directly instead of an isolated temporary SQLite database or test transaction rollback.
Production agents ('MICHAEL', 'VERVE', 'FLUX', 'AHMAD', 'DWIGHT', 'PAM', 'KELLY', 'QUANTUM', 'DEVDYNAMO', 'DATAEINSTEIN', 'RECON', 'NEWBIEAGENT') remain intact with valid schema.
SQLite database integrity check ('PRAGMA integrity_check;') returns 'ok'.
WAL journal mode and triggers remain fully functional.
Git tracked core files show no corruption; untracked test artifacts are isolated in qa_artifacts/.

recommendations: Run an explicit cleanup pass to delete leftover test agents ('TEST_RESTRICTED_ATTE', 'SECURITY_AUDIT_L0', 'SNEAKYL0AGENT') from config/agents.json.
Purge test conversations and stress-test turns (session_ids with test prefixes, AGENT_ALPHA, AGENT_BETA) from memory/zezo_brain.db.

For future QA test suites, mandate temporary isolated database fixtures (e.g. tempfile SQLite paths or in-memory clones) rather than pointing tests directly to memory/zezo_brain.db and config/agents.json.
